messages.author: 25ddb7cda687795b
messages.subject: control left margin
parts:
Hi all,

in an ordinary ggplot, there is from left to right:
- plot.margin[4]
- axis.title.y
- axis.text.y
- axis.ticks.margin
- axis.ticks.length
- border of the plot area
- ...
(I am not sure, this is complete, though)

My question is:
How can I control the space up to the border of the plotting area?

As an example, I'd like the border of the plotting area to be 2cm from
the left border of the device -- independently from my
labels/fontsizes/etc.


I hope, the question is clear.

Many thanks in advance.

Regards,
Andreas

As far as I know, your best bet is to tweak the gtable object before drawing. I had an example of such manips to align multiple plotting areas:

https://gist.github.com/baptiste/2877821

HTH,

baptiste
